title: Plasma Globe Oracle
description: A glowing plasma globe with purple and blue electrical arcs sits on a metallic base, containing the face of a dark-haired woman with orange lips and a hand pressed against the glass. A human hand reaches from the right, index finger extended toward the sphere, emitting a bright blue lightning bolt.
prompt: A surreal nighttime scene featuring a large plasma globe on a metallic stand with swirling purple energy at its base. Inside the transparent sphere, the face of a beautiful dark-haired woman with orange lips and a hand are visible, surrounded by bright purple and cyan electrical arcs emanating from a central glowing orb. A human hand enters from the right, index finger nearly touching the globe as a powerful blue lightning bolt connects to it. Dark city skyline in the background under a deep teal night sky.
